notes: EA-LSTM not trained / no hindcast: gate NOT decided, LightGBM stays production
LightGBM's test fit is retrained on data through 2024 (walk-forward); the EA-LSTM is trained on 2016-2023 only (2024 = early stopping), so on test LightGBM has one more year of training data.
Spatial holdout: the EA-LSTM never saw these reaches; LightGBM variant A was trained on them (reach_id feature) - not a like-for-like comparison.
seasonal_naive is a point forecast: no interval, no calibration, CRPS = MAE.
